label: Sequence starting with l, mid original phase (t=3-6), after s/f/p tokens, boosted by input x
explanation: Sparse feature that fires almost only in sequences whose first original token is l (97% of activation mass). It is active only at steps t=3-7, peaking at t=4-5, in the late original phase or on the <DEL> step (11% of mass). It never fires in the copy phase or at t<3. Within l-initial sequences, activation is graded and appears additive: it is larger when more of s, f, p have come earlier (prev_tok / prev2_tok s/f/p have about 8-10x lift), and largest when the current input is x (31% of mass; top examples are l p f f [x], l f s p f [x]). The broad context (first_tok l, t 3-7, phase <= 1) covers 97% of mass but only 2% precision. The chosen predicate (at least 2 of s/f/p seen, or at least 1 seen plus input x) gets dev F1 0.43 and mass recall 0.74. Many l-initial sequences with s/f/p stay inactive, so the feature looks like a thresholded conjunction of l-first, position, and s/f/p/x evidence, not a clean boolean.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=l (+8.39), prev_tok=f (+3.60), orig2=p (+3.44), orig1=l (+3.32), prev_tok=s (+3.31), orig0=2 (+2.95). Lower it: phase=2 (-3.26), prev3_tok=- (-2.99), t=8 (-2.14), orig1=c (-2.06).
